Klasse AbstractMoves

java.lang.Object
feu.agenten.shogo_seifert.AbstractMoves
Bekannte direkte Unterklassen:
AttackMoves, DefensiveMoves, ExpansionMoves, StepOneMoves
public abstract class AbstractMoves extends Object
The abstract base class for all Move-classes. AbstractMoves provides functionality, common methods and fall-back moves that are required by other, concrete Move-subclasses.

    • takeFerniesFromBudget

      protected GameUtils.MoveResult takeFerniesFromBudget(Map<Integer,Integer> budget, GameModel gm, int limit, int necessary, double[] take, OrderMap order)
      This method builds a move String of multiple moves that take Fernies from owned nodes, updates the budget map accordingly and return also the sum of the taken Fernies. The combined move String and the sum are attributes of the returned GameUtils.MoveResult object.

      The method iteratively takes Fernies from owned nodes until the given number, which is the parameter necessary is reached or no further Fernies can be taken.

      For each double entry in take, the budget entries are processed in the order, given as the order parameter. (@code ASC, DEC, RND}.

      For each node, a part of the Fernie on it gets taken. The limit ensures, that at least this number of Fernies will remain on the node.

      The number of Fernies of each node gets validated against the current game state provided by the GameModel gm to prevent inconsistencies.

      Parameter:
      budget - the map of Nodes of the currently available Fernies per owned Node
      gm - the current GameModel representing the current game state
      limit - the minimum of Fernies that should remain on each node
      necessary - the number of Fernies that should be taken
      take - the fractions defining how aggressively Fernies should be taken each iteration
      order - the order in which the owned Nodes are iterated over
      Gibt zurück:
      a GameUtils.MoveResult object that contains and represents the combined move String of taken Fernies and the total number of taken Fernies

    • fightEnemyWithAbsFernies

      public String fightEnemyWithAbsFernies(Node enemy, List<Node> myNodes, int ferniesUse, Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Attempts to attack a given enemy node with a given number of Fernies.

      If the attack is not possible due to the strength of the enemy node combined with the strengths of its neighbors, a fallback move is applied.

      Parameter:
      enemy - the enemy Node that gets attacked
      myNodes - the list of Nodes owned by the agent
      ferniesUse - the number of Fernies available for attacking the enemy Node
      budget - the budget of the Fernies currently available
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the action, or an empty String if the given enemy node was null

    • fightEnemy

      public String fightEnemy(Node enemy, List<Node> myNodes, Map<Integer,Integer> budget, int limit)
      Attempts to attack a given enemy node by calculating the best placement for it.

      If the attack is not possible due to the strength of the enemy node combined with the strengths of its neighbors, a fallback move is applied. Other fallback moves are applied for different edge cases.

      Parameter:
      enemy - the enemy Nodes that gets attacked
      myNodes - the list of Nodes owned by the agent
      budget - the budget of the Fernies currently available
      limit - minimum number of Fernies that shall stay on a Node after the move
      Gibt zurück:
      move String representing the action, or an empty String if the given enemy Node was null

    • putNewFerniesOnMaxNode

      public String putNewFerniesOnMaxNode(Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Places the new Fernies on the node owned by the agent with the highest number of Fernies.

      For several edge cases, fallback moves are applied.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies currently available
      Gibt zurück:
      a String move representing the action or an empty String if no maxNode was found

    • putNewFerniesSmart

      public String putNewFerniesSmart(Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Distributes the new Fernies on nodes that have not reached the maximum capacity per node set by the game.

      If the preferred action is not possible or for edge cases, a fallback move is applied.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies currently available
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the action or fallback move or an empty String if the new Fernies were <=0

    • newFerniesRandomMyOrNeutralNode

      public String newFerniesRandomMyOrNeutralNode(Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Distributes the new Fernies of the step randomly on neutral nodes or nodes owned by the agent.

      Fernies get placed on the nodes incrementally if a node has reached the maximum number of Fernies per node until the given number is exhausted.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies currently available
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the action or an empty String if not ring or no neutral or owned Nodes are available

    • nextNeutralMaxStep

      public String nextNeutralMaxStep(Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Places new Fernies on each visible neutral node and shifts all Fernies of the strongest node on one node next to it. This move is useful for a game setting with the visibility range of 1.
      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies currently available
      Gibt zurück:
      move String representing the placing action or an empty String, if the ring is null

    • newFerniesNextNeutal

      public String newFerniesNextNeutal(Map<Integer,Integer> budget)
      Places the currently available new Fernies on the next visible neutral node. This move is especially useful for game settings with a visibility range of 1, when it should be certain that new Fernies are getting placed on a neutral node.
      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies currently available
      Gibt zurück:
      move String representing the placing action or an empty String, if the ring is null

    • absFerniesRandomNeutralNode

      public String absFerniesRandomNeutralNode(Map<Integer,Integer> budget, int absFernies)
      Places a given number of Fernies on a random node out of a list of neutral nodes.

      Usually is used as a fall back move to use the rest of Fernies not placed by other moves.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies currently available
      absFernies - the number of Fernies to place
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String representing the action or a String representing the move of the fallback action of #absFerniesRandomNode(Map, int) or an empty String if the given number of Fernies was <= 0
